description: This PHP source file defines a class 'Image_Canvas_Tool' that contains a set of static utility functions related to image processing, such as font mapping, geometric calculations, and Bezier curve computations.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_Tool
classes.description: A utility class providing static functions for image-related geometric and font mapping operations.

methods.name: fontMap
methods.description: Maps a font name to an actual font file, searching known directories and translating names based on a font map file.

methods.name: mid
methods.description: Returns the average of two points.

methods.name: mirror
methods.description: Mirrors a point in relation to another point by a specified factor.

methods.name: controlPoint
methods.description: Calculates a Bezier control point to facilitate smooth curve creation.

methods.name: bezier
methods.description: Calculates a point on a Bezier curve given a parameter t and four control points.

methods.name: getAngle
methods.description: Calculates the angle of a line segment relative to the horizontal axis.
